## An R Introduction.

## loading external data

```{r }
data<-read.csv("mouse.csv")
data<-data[-1,]
plot(data[,1],main = "plot")
image(as.matrix(data[,2:15]),col=c("red","blue"),main="Mouse Data",ylab="Markers",xlab="Individual")
reg1<-lm(BW~M1,data=data);reg1
summary(reg1)
plot(BW~M1,data=data)

```


```{r}
for(i in 2:15){
  print(table(data[,i]))
}

i<-2
while(i<15){
  print(table(data[,i]))
  i<-i+1
}
```


Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
